proof_roadmap: Build nested clopen copy of Y and split finite orbits to mimic Delta inside Sigma.
Build Lambda by compatible permutation embeddings; establish minimality, thinness, etaleness and induced Delta.
Extend embeddings to a containing conjugate of Gamma inducing Sigma.
Check malleability and both inclusions of the extended orbit relation, then conjugate back.
difficulty_reason: The proof simultaneously constructs two compatible inductive systems of finite permutation groups and nested clopen partitions. Its orbit splitting and fragment allocation enforce the prescribed Delta–Sigma inclusion while controlling minimality, asymptotic thinness, etaleness and induced restrictions. The second embedding must extend the first while making off-K extra permutations remain inside Lambda-orbits, enabling the final equality of equivalence relations. This nonroutine constrained construction, rather than the final use of classical conjugacy or the later absorption theorem, remains fully inside the counted proof.
